sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ba/-be expresses movement into a place or destination. It contrasts with -ban/-ben for being inside a place.

A common slip is grabbing -ban/-ben out of habit even when someone is moving, not resting. Ask yourself first: is this a snapshot of someone already there, or a shot of them heading there? Snapshot = -ban/-ben, heading there = -ba/-be.
